provenance.paper_title: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for GUI Agents

evidence.paraphrase: Discrete high-level symbolic nodes support multi-hop retrieval and working-memory refresh.
Continuous trajectory embeddings are linked to symbolic nodes and supplied to the GUI agent.
Fixed node operations merge or replace overlapping GUI experiences. For HyMEM, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of symbolic GUI memory graph.
Node updates reorganize the symbolic graph and its trajectory links. For HyMEM, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of symbolic GUI memory graph.
On-the-fly working-memory refresh updates the active task state. For HyMEM, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of symbolic GUI memory graph.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (symbolic GUI memory graph) changes through merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, relinking or reindexing of stored items, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
